nom: Clinique Take The Day Off Charcoal Cleansing Balm Makeup Remover

avis.texte: This is the best makeup remover. It makes removing make up easy and leaves my skin feeling clean and soft

I guess I got this in a GWP, just found it and used it. i personaly like the original, no charcoal better. I am not understanding what the charcoal does except get all over my face cloth. I didn't like the black color on my face, what is the point of that? And also the sample I got smelled rancid like another reviewer. Just a hard NO for me.
Stick with the original. This smells awful!!! Like rancid play-doh.
This removes ALL makeup, including eyeliner and mascara. It is a little messy once you rinse with wet hands, but my skin has NEVER gotten this clean with any other product.
I received it as a gift while buying other products I love the texture and how it melts the makeup

I got this to remove Nyx Epic Wear Eyeliner, and it did the job. Where I had to scrub it off prior, this took it right off. Unfortunately, I seem to be allergic! It has dramatically increased the lines around my eyelids, and they are puffy, dry, and rough to the touch. I hope they heal, because it looks awful.

The product I received has a stale, rancid smell. I wouldn't use it on my skin or anyone else's. I'm not sure if this is how it is supposed to smell or if I've received an old, expired product. I'm usually happy with Clinique products, order them often, and highly recommend them, but not this one.
This works just as great as the original Take The Day Off. However, I thought the smell was terrible. I personally couldn't get past it. I would just buy the original.
I mean, the product works, but its slightly sticky and it smells like Play-Doh. Not a fan.

I love this cleansing balm. It works so well at removing makeup. My face is clean and feels great. As far as the charcoal part that some are complaining about, I have had no issues with stains. I actually like tje fact that the black/grey is easy to spot in my sink and rinses away so easily.

I tried this because I love the regular Take Off the Day balm. I have oily skin, and the regular actually seemed to help it, so I thought the charcoal version would be amazing. It does leave a film on the face, as did the original, but my toner took care of that. The charcoal version is so messy and will get all over anything it touches, or drips on when rinsing off. I decided to only use it in the shower because of this. All that being said, my skin is happy with it, but I'll probably switch back to the original version.

I'm utterly amazed how good this Take the day off charcoal balm works!!! I can have full face makeup on and this balm gently removes it all!!! I have oily to dry skin (and sometimes sensitive) and I had no irritations whatsoever! I'll forever be a repeat customer for this product!

I normally love Clinique products, but I HATE this one. The smell is AWFUL! It doesn't remove makeup, just smears it. And finally, leaves a film on face that my cleanser can't take off (nor does the cleanser get rid of the smell). So disappointed that I wasted any money on this product.

I've used Clinique for over 30 years. Always love the products. However I don't like this make up remover balm. Way too greasy for my already oily skin. Feels like crisco on my face. And it smells terrible, like old used cooking oil.
I really love these balm it takes off my whole full face makeup. I really recommend this product.
This product is very greasy and messy. It does clean, but there are so many other better cleansers that Clinique makes. I would not buy this again.

avis.titre: This product is great...if you like giant messes
avis.texte: I only gave this product 2 stars because it does technically remove makeup like it claims to. But everything else about it is absolutely awful. No matter how careful I am when using it, I always end up with black hair, black hands, black countertops, a black sink, a black towel. This product makes a HUGE mess and stains literally everything. It smells weird. And the charcoal doesn't actually do anything it claims to, so there's no point for it to even be in the product. I would easily put this on a list of my top 3 least favorite products of all time. The original Clinique cleansing balm without the charcoal is great though! Go for that one instead.
I really like this product. At first I was skeptical, but it rinses off nicely. This is my new favorite.

This charcoal containing remover works better for my super oily skin in comparison to original balm. I'm removing one star for incorrect description " for dry combination to oily skin". For dry or dry combination skin types try the original ( white) product

avis.titre: Wanted to love this but it stains
avis.texte: I loved this product initially. It feels nice on my skin and takes off a day of heavy makeup! It unfortunately also stained my bathroom counter tops. I have scrubbed them repeatedly and am left with ugly purple stains. I also had on a Samsung watch with a cream band that is permanently stained as well. Very upsetting.

I've been using this product for over a year and it has been fantastic. I have oily skin and this is the only balm I've found that works for me. I bought a new one a week ago and its not the same! I knew it was different the second I rubbed my hands together. It's really oily and very difficult to wash off completely. I used it every day to see how it affected my skin. Unfortunately it made me breakout terribly. Maybe I got a bad one? 🤷‍♀️ I will be returning it and I wont risk repurchasing in hopes it was a bad batch. Back to the drawing board😞

I got this product as a sample. I have had good experiences with Clinique products in the past and in regards to how well it cleans off my makeup, it works well and it isn't drying. However, the product has this strong, awful rancid cooking oil smell.

This is my favorite makeup remover, and I am not on my way to trying the one without charcoal. I love this product because it eliminated the need to use wipes or cotton pads and can be simply washed off with water
Love the way it tingles a touch as you massage it into your face. You can feel it . A deeper clean than the original
It works at removing makeup like foundation and mascara but my eyes burned for hours after using and washing off. Won't be using again.

I usually purchase the regular Take the Day Off cleansing balm but I decided to try this one with the charcoal.. I really love the way it makes my skin feel so soft and clean! This has actually helped my pores look better and I wasn't expecting to see a real difference between the 2 cleansing balm products. I have very large pores and this product has made the pores look smaller. I wish I had of tried it earlier because I really love this product! When I put it on I rub into my skin really good and leave it for a couple minutes then rinse my splashing water on to my face and follow with the jelly cleanser. I see some people just wipe off with a dry cloth. But I have sensitive skin so I always want to make sure I get it all off. It doesn't make a mess in the sink like some charcoal cleansers do. It rinses off nicely. This is my new favorite!

I received a sample and at first thought this wouldn't be a great option for my oily skin, however, I was so excited to find out how great this product is! The container makes it easy to grab the perfect amount and a little goes a long way. I like to put it on before my shower and rub it in, allowing it to dissolve the make up. Then a few quick wipes and a pump of my oily skin liquid soap and I feel so clean and ready for my clarifying lotion 4 and my DD gel! I am really excited that this was a new offering. I'd love to see it available in a travel size more often, as I travel for work and the larger jar is a bit bulky for travel.

I realize it's black in color and can't "see" that all the makeup is taken off (this was recommended to me because I have combo skin) but it doesn't leave a greasy residue on my skin after cleansing it and my skin doesn't feel stripped.

I recieved the sample Charcoal 'Take the day off' cleansing balm and I honestly didn't expect to like it because the regular one didnt work for my skin and (now as a 36 yr old) most things make my face feel dry— even when it advertises that it wont. I am so happy I got to try the charcoal version because it's exactly what I've been looking for. This product doesnt make my face dry at all, and its effective AND gentle. I love it and I highly recommend!

I purchased the large origional clear pomade of this brand along with other Clinique products which got me decent size samples including the newest "charcoal" pomade. Since I have both, there's not much difference I can tell you between the two. They both work the same, eitherway the product works great and still very gentle on eyes while still removing all the built up makeup breaking it up easy while dry. The only bad thing I'd say is this that this is NOT your one stop remover and will absolutely need to follow up with their cleanser or you will breakout because it breaks down but it won't clear and wash it all off. Its fine, and I personally like this system leaving me squeaky clean.

This is a great cleansing balm, the bad reviews I keep seeing are of people wiping it off their face. first of all this balm should be applied to the face then should begin to activate with water which turns it into a milky consistency as it begins to remove all traces of makeup. You should then follow up with a gel based cleanser. Your skin should be left feeling clean this way, hope this helps!
I wanted to like this product but it just didn't seem to work well with removing the eye makeup.
I received this as a free sample. After using just one time I had an allergic reaction all around my eyes.

I received this as a free sample along with an eye cream sample. I wasn't sure if I would like it or not, but I decided to deviate from my normal routine and try it. I'm so glad that I did. It's so smooth and silky going on. I have seen some reviews that people say it's hard to wipe off and have given 1 star. You need to wash it off like regular cleanser not try and wipe it. If used properly, it leaves your skin feeling very hydrated and soft. I will definitely be adding this product to my routine and will purchase once my sample runs out.

I received a trial size of the charcoal remover and decided to try it. First, it smelled of petroleum, a very chemical smell, and stained my washcloth when I wanted to remove it. I cannot think of ever using this product when so many other options are available.

Let me start by saying This is NOT a cleanser on its own. I see so many bad reviews about this product because it's not used properly. This is a FIRST STEP to remove makeup and sunscreen,only after this do you go in with a REGULAR cleanser. A good product is getting bad reviews because of operator error. This balm is amazing!!!! It melts into the skin beautifully. My skin is not left feeling dry,which has been the case with other cleansers. It takes off my sunscreen and mascara completely and most importantly it doesn't cause my super picky princess skin to break out. Will continue to use this forever ❤️.

The review system won't let me give it NO stars, which is what it deserves. Thank goodness I didn't actually pay $$ for it, but rec'd it as a sample. It's messy to use, takes a ton of tissues to wipe off (not good for the environment), didn't remove all my eye makeup and irritated my eyes (despite the claim that it is good for sensitive skin and eyes). If you want a good eye makeup remover, stick with the tried & true Take the Day Off Makeup Remover for Lids, Lashes & Lips.

I love this product. In the winter my skin gets so dry and itchy and I can't hydrate it enough. I used this today an was impressed how well it removed my waterproof mascara, eye makeup without burning my eyes. Followed up with take the day off wash and applied my super hydration lotion and all about eyes. My face feels so good. I'm thinking after using daily for the next week my skin should be back to normal.

I wasn't looking for this take the day off balm but tried it after I received it in my Ipsy bag. I am pleasantly surprised how soft and refreshed my broken out skin feels. My hard to remove eye liner and eyeshadow came right off really using it with my make up eraser. Usually the makeup eraser cloth doesn't remove all my eye make up on its own. My skin is very sensitive, oily and acne prone but it's helped to calm my break out without over drying it.
I'm sold on this product it is my new fav for full and deep cleansing after a full face of make up. It dissolves make up immediately even working on tough to move waterproof liquid liner!

I am still on the fence with this product, I have always used the original and loved it! I don't feel it removes mascara as well and it's a bit messy. I will continue to use this bottle in hopes that I will eventually love it.

avis.titre: Doesn't clean very well waterproof mascara
avis.texte: I'm not very pleased, it does not removed very well waterproof mascara. I used to use the take the day off original and works very well for waterproofing
I love how this mask just glides over my face. It's so silky smooth. Does wonders for my skin.

I was really hoping to love this product. I loved the Charcoal mask so I figured this must be just as good. Unfortunately, I was wrong. I tried to use it over my eyes to wipe off my mascara, etc. and it burned horribly bad. To the point that it took hours to see out of my eyes again. I'm hoping at some the sensitive eye remover will come back in stock. That is only thing that doesn't burn my eyes after using it. Like I said, I really wanted to like this but unfortunately I just couldn't. I hope it works well for other people besides me.
Will definitely be buying this product again. This is the absolute best makeup remover product I have ever used.
Paste texture, dug out a lump, palm press a press to become waxy state, massage in the face for a while into oil, but not greasy, clean makeup.

"Take the Day Off" is a super make up remover - although I prefer the plain to the charcoal -- the tint of black gets under my nails and soaks into my dry cracked skin on my hands and I have to scrub off the residue ... meantime this product removes every trave of mascara and rouge! I have been buying this product for many years - it's excellent! ML

My skin has never looked so good! I've been using this for a couple weeks and I have seen a dramatic change in my skin. Clogged pores and blackheads are gone! My skin is so soft and clear it's unreal. After rinsing the charcoal balm I use the acne solutions cleansing bar, then apply even better brightening essence lotion and dramatically different moisturizer. My skin looks better without makeup than it does with it now. I'm sold!

I've tried their original balm and it made me feel quite oily. Then I decided to try this one & ended up loving it. I haven't mastered how much to use bc I was using way too much in the beginning but I think I've started getting to the normal amount. So far, I really like it & buying it again.

avis.titre: Worst clinique product - Have been using clinique for years
avis.texte: I have been using cliniqe products for several years now so trusted that this charcoal take the day off cleansing balm would be good too. I have sensitive skin and was excited to see a charcoal based product, on the first day I used this - the smell was strange but I still tried it on. The next day I used it again, and since just the 2nd use my skin broke out like crazy - I never never never get pimple like bumps ever. It has been several days since I stopped using this after only the 2 times and still am dealing with the awful pimple like bumps. The smell is awful and so is the product. I am now dealing with skin problems and wasted money on this product which I will never use again, and now I have to find something and spend more money to reverse the side effects of this product. I really wanted to like this, but this product is terrible.

This is a cleansing powerhouse! This balm effortlessly melts away makeup, dirt, and impurities, leaving my skin feeling fresh and clean. The addition of charcoal provides an extra detoxifying boost, ensuring a deep and thorough cleanse. I love how easily it glides on and emulsifies with water, making rinsing a breeze.
A little goes a long way and made quick work of my eye makeup.
I have used the regular take the day off balm several times. This time I purchased the charcoal take the day off balm. It causes itching and burning. I am definitely going back to the regular balm.
use the take the day off series for many year, now, this new, updated charcoal cleansing balm. buy a mini one to try

I was very interested in trying this new product, so I took the mini version of the product. I really liked the balm, it cleans well, does not tighten the skin at all and gives a feeling of hydration. I will definitely buy a large format

I bought the Charcoal Cleansing Balm thinking I would love it and prefer it over the original. Not even close. It doesn't break down and stays in small clumps and I have tried it several times. Nowhere near as good as the original. Please Clinique do not discontinue the original cleansing balm it's much more effective and just a superior product. Nice try with this but the original cleansing supersedes this by 100. Keep the original around just like you have with the Clarifying lotions, tried and true!

Wow, this is so effective at removing all my makeup the first time! Leaves skin feeling soft and healthy! And best part, works on eye makeup while being gentle and not making my vision blurry like oil based removers do!
I love that Ulta has little travel or trial sizes. And yes, I will be buying a regular size Clinique Take Off The Day Charcoal Cleansing Balm

Received a trial size from a great sales person at Ulta. At first I was hesitant because I love my cleanser. Decided to give it a try and I LOVE it. Leaves your face so silky smooth. I do use my cleanser afterwards. I immediately noticed that when I use my toner I no longer have dirt/oil or faint traces of makeup on my cotton ball. The charcoal balm definitely pulls all of that from deeper in your pores than just the cleanser. Yes it does get a bit messy under you nails and in your cuticles but it's nothing you can't wash off with soap and water…or a spare tooth brush you keep handy for scrubbing under your nails. The product is well worth the extra 1 minute to clean under your nails.
I absolutely love this balm, it took off ALL of my makeup and left my skin clean. I have dry-combo skin (oily t-zone) and this did not make me feel stripped. I would recommend this.

I really like how this balm feels on my skin and removes makeup, including waterproof mascara. However, I don't like that the black balm gets behind my nails, deep into the cuticle, that is very difficult to remove. I would not buy again.

I received a sample of the "take the day off" cleansing balm when I had purchased another item. I put it on before taking a shower, then used a damp washcloth to wipe it off while showering. It works great on my face. It took me a while to realize that it was causing my ears to itch almost non-stop. So I stopped using it and my itching went away. I decided to try it again, but not in the shower and only used one finger to put it on my face. I used a damp washcloth to wipe it off and didn't get any on my hands. The finger that I used to put the balm on my face is itching so much even though I have washed my hands with soap and water a few times. I realize that this is a possibility for any product that we put on our skin, however, since there's no warning on the website about a possible allergic reaction or sensitivity, but I wanted to let you know.
this literally is the best makeup remover!! it doesn't take a whole lot, just a dab the size of a dime and your makeup will wash right away.
Got a trial size, then fell in love. Had to go and get a larger one !
This makeup remover is very clean and comfortable. I'll buy more

I have used many clinique makeup removers so it was nice to try the newer one. To be honest I am not a big fan of the hole black mess on my face, but it does what is supposed to and removes your makeup. I believe I will stay with the regular one but was nice to try this one for a change.
This cleaning effect is very good, and the face is very refreshing and clean after use. i take it more and more
I take brought version this balsam, but this is glory. My skin is glowing, smooth and shiny

I use this as night before I start my anti-aging skincare routine. It removes makeup, and I feel good about using charcoal that is supposed to detox my skin. Whether it works to detox or not, I don't know, but this cleanser does a great job and feels gentle on my face.
I don't know I just don't like this as much as the original.. it kind of drys out my skin.
I love this stuff! Leaves my face feeling so clean and renewed.
i love this cleanser a lot because of my skin type it helps because it doesn't dry me out

I couldn't believe this even makes the night before/daily excess moisturizer up and out of your pores. I was shocked when I saw the moisturizer residue rise out of my nose pores. Could do better for eyeliner residue but is amazing.

Ive used "Take the Day Off" for years and recently tried this new product with charcoal. This removes makeup with easy and leaves face feeling clean and oil free. I find that the charcoal formula leaves my face feeling more clean than the original version. I would highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: The Detoxifier: New Fav Makeup Remover
avis.texte: This detoxifying cleanser leave no oily or greasy residue. I love 💜 a good cleansing balm. It's important to me that the balm removes everything, including eye makeup. It totally does just that and leaves no unwanted residue. I give it ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ and totally recommend you try it. Check out my video demo.👇 https://youtu.be/8TQxwFYByZs

This product is amazing. I was using a different makeup removal balm before and it was kind of greasy, to the point I would sometimes wash my face with soap afterwards, and still sometimes there wouldbe mascara left behind. But this product works great! It's light, non-greasy and a little goes a long way.
This cleaning effect is very good, and the face is very refreshing and clean after use. It is a very easy-to-use cleaning product.

avis.titre: The cleaning effect is the best
avis.texte: Face cleaning is very clean and comfortable, and it is a very easy-to-use cleaning product.
I like this product very much. My face is very clean and my skin is in good condition when I use it.
I've been told to switch to a makeup removing balm for a while and I've always been skeptical as I'm a makeup wipe millennial. But this really removes everything from your face! Leaving it so soft!
This product has a very good cleaning effect. After use, the skin is clean and comfortable, and the skin is tender and smooth.
After use, the skin is very clean and comfortable, and the cleaning effect is very good. I like a product very much.

avis.titre: The cleaning effect is very good.
avis.texte: This product has a very good cleaning effect. After using it, the face is not tight, and it is very clean and comfortable. It is worth recommending.
I was looking for something that would remove my mascara, this definitely does not. It does a nice job of taking off the rest of my makeup.

I've been using the original cleansing balm since 2012. There is nothing like it! I tried this since my skin is on the oiler side and I struggle with breakouts from time to time. This is amazing! Leaves my skin feeling soft and clean. Doesn't feel drying at all.

avis.titre: Great First Step In A Double Cleanse
avis.texte: I enjoyed using this cleanser as the first step in my double cleansing routine. Removed most of my makeup (even stubborn mascara). Did not leave an oily residue. Super hydrating.

This does not take my eye makeup off like the Take The Day Off Balm. I also do not like the black of it. You cannot tell see the mascara come off like with the regular balm. I would never buy this. Do not get rid of the original!

avis.titre: Recommend make up balm for oily skin
avis.texte: This is the best balm and greatest part it has Japanese charcoal which will not clog the pores but remove impurities. Recommended for oily skin not for dry.

avis.titre: Leaves my skin feeling so clean!!!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this cleanser. I wear EL Double Wear foundation most days which doesn't come off easy and this does an amazing job of removing my makeup quickly and my skin feels so smooth and clean afterwards. I think my skin feels less oily throughout the day as well. My new go to nightly cleanser!!

avis.titre: I wanted to like this, but....
avis.texte: At first, I kinda liked it. It removed my makeup well, and then I'd go over with my regular cleanser. But the more I used it the more my skin seemed to reject it. It started breaking out and my skin didn't feel clean. It felt as though as I had a barrier on top of my skin that wouldn't wash off. When I quit using it, it went away. I've used other products like this and they seem to work better, but the micellar water works best for my skin. -- 41 y/o white female - no real acne problems. normal skin.

This did what it's supposed to do. Wasn't the type of charcoal to stain your face which is great. Easy to use and very nice product, although if you struggle with acne this won't be your friend. Anything with charcoal will purge the skin. As someone Using acne fighting products 24/7 to minimize my breakouts and cystic acne , I don't want something that's going to bring them to the surface every time I take my make up off and new dark spots to fight off.

avis.titre: Love it takes off waterproof mascara
avis.texte: I've been searching for something Ike this that I don't have to actually wash face every night I've used this last few nights and extremely happy with taking off makeup ex specially waterproof mascara!! It's fabulous I'm in love and will be purchasing more!

I enjoyed removing my make up and cleansing my face with the balm. Removes the majority of impurities and doesn't leave the face greasy. When you apply, it melts in your face like a light oil. It is not harsh on the skin. Definitely recommend.

I was a Clinique girl for many years but haven't returned for products in a long time. I thrive on clean, nonsense beauty that is healthy for my skin and is hassle free to apply (otherwise it would take the self-care enjoyment out of it) I had never tried the Take the Day Off. I went for the charcoal because my skin is combination oily to normal. This product does not sting my eyes (and I dwell on them) and it does not leave a greasy residue either. It leaves my skin feeling sift and clean, while removing all my makeup. I follow up with regular cleanser. I love this product!

It's a cleansing balm for skin types 2, 3 and 4. I don't understand why there's Japanese charcoal in here. Does that make the product sound fancier? Maybe it's a marketing ploy but it will absolutely strip your skin and dry it out. It is super pricey for a basic cleansing balm that may be in contact with skin for 53 seconds straight before it gets washed off, totally unnecessary to spend this much if you ask me. There is nothing in here that would warrant the ridiculous price-tag.

avis.titre: Good, but not the OG TTDO!
avis.texte: I am a long time user of the original TTDO Balm and LOVE it! I was excited about this new version and hoped I would love it… but, it does not seem to tackle my waterproof/hard to remove make-up as well. I will certainly stick to the original.
I prefer the original balm but I still did enjoy this product. Works well to remove makeup.
I did not like the black getting under my nails and made a mess. I love the original and went back to it.

avis.titre: Did a job on my face
avis.texte: Felt a bit abrasive on my skin and left my skin stinging. I don't think I'll use it again.

I've used the original cleansing balm in the past and liked it but didnt completely love it. this new version is so much better than the original. its lighter weight and doesn't leave a greasy film after rinsing it off. I wear a lot of makeup and it removes everything. it leaves myface feeling clean and hydrated.

I really like this charcol version. It makes my skin feel silky smooth. It removes my water proof mascara easily and doesn't leave a film on my eyes. It also removes completely easily with cold water which is awesome.

I've been using the original cleansing balm religiously for years - it's the only makeup remover product that I really feel like it gets ALL of my makeup off: SPF and all. When I saw the new charcoal version I knew I had to give it a try. I like the texture of the balm, it's a bit smoother and creamier than the original. However because the product is black, it's hard to tell whether or not I've gotten all of my eye makeup off. When I get out of the shower (I use this before I get in, wipe it off, and then double cleanse in the shower), I look like a little raccoon haha! This will take some getting used to, and a little more effort on my part, but I'd still recommend this for sure

avis.titre: Not as good as the original
avis.texte: I've been using the original TTDO Balm for years and swear by it! I was so excited about this formulation, only to find it's nowhere near as good as the original. I found this far harder to remover, and it didn't remove the makeup I had on easily at all, despite it just being tinted moisturizer not set with powder. Stick to the original!
I wanted to love this cleansing balm, but the texture threw me off. It didn't spread easily and I felt like I had to scrub at my skin to make it blend.

Very impressed with this. I definitely think I like this one better than the original. Does an amazing job at getting off all of my makeup, my skin felt super soft, it actually felt clean afterwards, and the charcoal benefits are really nice. Only con is that it's a little messy because it's black but it's something I can live with.
I absolutely love this new product. I have combination skin it was super gentle on my skin. It feels like a balm it glides into the skin. My skin felt smooth and clear and clean.

Over the last year, I've gotten really into double cleansing. While I don't do it every day, I double cleanse a few times a week and I always double cleanser when taking off makeup. I was really excited to see that Clinique came out with a Charcoal Cleansing Balm!! It has all the amazing benefits of charcoal in a easy-to-use, effective cleansing balm. Formulated with Japanese Charcoal, Safflower Seed Oil and and linoleic acid, this is my new favorite product when I double cleanse. It removes almost all traces of everything and anything on my face, rinses clean and doesn't leave any weird residues. It's also not greasy, drying, or stripping and it's non-acnegenic, which is always a concern of mine, especially when using any product containing oils. I love how the balm turns into an oil when applied and dissolves even my most stubborn waterproof eyeliners and mascaras. This is definitely a product I'll be using long term- and I even got my mom using it!!!

I was excited to try this charcoal cleansing balm, since I never had before, so I was happy and grateful to receive this Clinique product complimentary from BzzAgent. I don't think this was for my skin type, which is dry. I think that it's supposed to be for all soon types, but I would only recommend this to those with combination to oily skin. It made my dry skin rather tight after using it. I'm going to have to personality not use this and stick to my thick, creamy, and hydrating cleaning balms and oils!
Super easy to use balm. Perfect for combination skin. I have dry skin and this balm worked pretty well. Specially for water proof mascara or eyeliner
This stuff is so amazing, it makes taking make up off so easy!

This does a decent job at removing makeup. I find that it takes a bit more work to remove eye makeup compared to other balms, though. It doesn't leave residue on my face, is very smooth, and leaves a minimal film over my eyes. The original Clinique balm really made my vision blurry afterwards, so I was pleasantly surprised that this one wasn't so bad!

I have used take the day off in its original form for years. It works on all makeup including eye makeup. This charcoal version is less creamy and doesn't seem to work as well on eye makeup as the original. It seems to need more product to clean the whole face too
I really enjoyed Cliniques take the day off Charcoal cleanising balm it deep cleened my face and left it feeling smooth.
I love clinique's original makeup removing balm and this one is just as great. Love the extra layer of cleanliness I get from the activated charcoal.
